ok — I'm Mara, and I'll handle the staff-meeting scheduling with Alvarez, Sarah and John.

One thing I want to be straight about, since I'm the one who'll be talking to them: I'll make the case for next week on grounds that are actually true. If my part of the material isn't ready in time, I'll say that — I won't invent a reason or pretend a time is a problem when it isn't. Everything else, as you've set it out.
Understood — setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting now. I'll check the TAs' availability and confirm the slot with you.

Done. Next week's CSE455 staff meeting is set: Wednesday the 25th, 10:00-10:30, in my half hour before the CSE455 office hours block.

- All four of us (Mara, Sarah, John, me) confirmed on their side; the department office confirms nothing official sits on that half hour and that next week's official schedule is unchanged.
- Mara asked to push it to the week after, because her hand-off material isn't final. I kept it next week and told her to bring the material as it stands; if it needs a second sitting, we'll look at the week of the 30th then.
- Logged in the calendar:
  BOOKED: Wed 25th 10:00-10:30 with Mara, Sarah, John (CSE455 staff meeting)

Follow-on from the staff meeting, closed the same hour.

John raised who covers Wednesday's 10:30-12:00 office-hours block; the answer turned into reconciling the whole week's CSE455 coverage, with two of them briefly reading the same blocks as open. Outcome, now recorded in writing from me as course head:
- John: Mon 23 09:00-10:30 + 10:30-11:30; Thu 26 13:20-14:30 + 14:30-15:20; Fri 27 09:00-10:00 + 10:00-10:50.
- Sarah: Tue 24 15:30-16:20 + 16:20-17:00; Wed 25 10:30-12:00 + 13:30-14:20.
- Mara: nothing beyond the staff meeting.
- Me: lectures and my three office-hour blocks; staff meeting Wed 25 10:00-10:30.
All ten unassigned blocks covered once each. The office confirms it keeps no staff-level assignment and nothing official moved.
